audit.whatIsWrong: Teemo's Q was written as "Blinding Shot" in spikes[0].text, wants.you[0], early and whys[5].
audit.why: Riot's name for Teemo's Q is Blinding Dart. "Blinding Shot" does not exist.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in the content layer told the player to buy Grievous Wounds, even though the whole Teemo gameplan here is chip damage.
audit.why: Indestructible (W) stores damage Mordekaiser deals and takes into a shield he can then consume to HEAL, on a 12/11/10/9/8s cooldown. Teemo's damage is poison chip, which is exactly the profile that shield-into-heal converts away. Grievous Wounds timing therefore decides every extended trade, and Oblivion Orb is cheap enough to slot on the pre-Riftmaker recall.
audit.corrected: Buy Oblivion Orb on the recall before his Riftmaker completes so anti-heal is live the first time he recasts Indestructible as a heal.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns carried no real numbers and named only Realm of Death.
audit.why: Realm of Death is 140/120/100s, but the cooldown that actually decides lane trades is Death's Grasp (E) at 16/14/12/10/8s — it is the pull that lets a melee champion touch Teemo at all. Indestructible is 12/11/10/9/8s. Naming the 16s E window gives the player a concrete trade cue instead of a vague ult warning.
audit.corrected: Track Death's Grasp at 16s rank 1 as the lane cooldown; Realm of Death at 140s is the recall/level-6 cue.

audit.why: whys[5]'s claim that Darkness Rise bypasses the blind holds up: Darkness Rise is a damage aura, and blind only causes basic attacks to miss. The claim was worth keeping, so I fixed only the ability name inside it.
54.57% over 722 games matches the data already in the file.

edits.before: Poison stacks compound with Blinding Shot: Q him as he walks up for the passive, then E-poke between his W shield pulses to drain the shield before he can threaten the E pull.
edits.after: Poison stacks compound with Blinding Dart: Q him as he walks up for the passive, then E-poke between his W shield pulses to drain the shield before he can threaten the E pull.

edits.before: Land Blinding Shot the instant he walks up for passive autos or an E pull attempt, stripping his only reliable damage window
edits.after: Land Blinding Dart the instant he walks up for passive autos or an E pull attempt, stripping his only reliable damage window

edits.before: At level 1 Mordekaiser has no ranged tool — he must walk through your Toxic Shot poison to last-hit, and his passive Darkness Rise autos need three hits to proc. Every time he steps up, fire Blinding Shot to deny those passive autos entirely; without them his level 1 damage is just slow Q swings at melee range he cannot reach. He has no escape either, so plant your first mushroom in the lane brush by level two so you never lose vision of his approach angle. The kill threat is low for both sides at level 1, which is why this stage belongs to him on the cross-locked chart only in the sense that his kit is a short-range brawler by design — your job is simply to convert that into free poke without stepping into E-pull range.

edits.before: Riftmaker completed means his W shield absorbs your poison burst and his passive damage bypasses Blinding Shot; trading into a shielded Mordekaiser now loses you the lane lead you built.
edits.after: Riftmaker means his W shield eats your poison burst and Darkness Rise bypasses Blinding Dart; with no Grievous Wounds on you he recasts Indestructible as a heal and wins the long trade.

edits.before: Mordekaiser's Riftmaker spike here is dangerous — his W shield absorbs your burst and his passive autos chunk you; force pre-item damage leads or disengage rather than trading into a shielded all-in.
edits.after: Mordekaiser's Riftmaker spike here is dangerous — Indestructible banks your poison as shield and he recasts it into a heal; buy Oblivion Orb on this same recall so Grievous Wounds is live before he out-sustains you.

edits.before: His R isolates you — build MR, shroom + poke pre-6. Teemo wins the Realm of Death cooldown windows.
edits.after: His R isolates you — build MR and anti-heal, shroom + poke pre-6. Teemo wins the Death's Grasp windows.

edits.before: Build MR, blind + shroom-kite him. Track Realm of Death before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Build MR and Grievous Wounds, then blind and shroom-kite. Track Death's Grasp before every commit and hold the wave.

edits.before: - Mordekaiser Realm of Death: matchup-defining — His 1v1 realm. Shroom-kite him in it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Mordekaiser Realm of Death: 140s at rank 1 — his 1v1 realm; seed your exit shroom before he hits 6. - Death's Grasp: 16s at rank 1, the pull that starts every combo — sidestep it and he has nothing. - Indestructible: 12s heal-shield.

notes: champ-data/_kits/mordekaiser.json derives a "grounding" flag on Obliterate (Q). That looks like a text artifact from "smashes the ground" — Obliterate is a damage zone, not a grounding effect. I did not build any advice on it. content.mid contains the phrase "a grounded Teemo inside his melee range", which reads as ordinary English rather than the Grounded status, so I left it alone.
